jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3 years of programming experience and good knowledge of complexity and data structures (C++ preferred; Java or Python acceptable) M.A. degree with strong quantitative training such as Math, Physics, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering with high grades (exception: exceptional B.A. with at least 3 full years of relevant work experience) Strong analytical and mathematical skills

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years of hands-on DevOps and/or MLOps experience designing, deploying, and supporting production cloud environments B.Sc. in Computer Science Strong cloud engineering expertise (scalable multi-service architectures, complex networking, production infrastructure design)
